title: Canonical open representative and pinned counit compatibility
statement: Let g prime:X prime to X, opens U,U prime, and j:U prime to U satisfy the commuting inclusion equation. Choose derived categories of module sheaves. For every cochain complex P on X let K=Q(P), Q0=restriction(P), a:Q(Q0) isomorphic to restriction(K) be the inverse exact localization factor, theta the restricted identity coefficient [def-pc-single-complex-open-restriction-data], and beta the ordinary localized restriction map [def-pc-single-complex-open-tensor-restriction-iso]. Then Lj*(a.hom) followed by theta and restriction of the pinned counit at P equals the pinned j-counit at Q0 followed by beta. No K-flatness, base scheme, cartesian square, stalk or cohomology degree is involved.

proof.text: Specialize the existing homotopy counit restriction equation to the quotient of P. The homotopy exact localization factor at a quotient complex is the complex localization factor, after cancelling the identity quotient comparison factors.

Precompose with Lj* of the inverse exact factor. Postcompose with the inverse localized homotopy tensor restriction isomorphism and the inverse target exact factor. Cancel inverse isomorphisms. The right-hand composite is exactly beta.

theorem singleComplexOpen_termwise_counit_compatibility
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (U : X.Opens) (U' : X'.Opens) (j : U'.toScheme ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (hj : j ≫ U.ι = U'.ι ≫ g')
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) :
    letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X U).Additive := schemeOpenRestriction_additive X U
    letI : (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').Additive := schemeOpenRestriction_additive X' U'
    let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
    let Q := ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let a := (schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.symm.app P
    let θ := singleComplexRestrictedCoefficient g' K ((derivedPullback g').obj K) (𝟙 _)
      U U' j hj
    (derivedPullback j).map a.hom ≫ θ ≫
        (schemeOpenRestriction X' U').mapDerivedCategory.map
          ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℤ)).obj P)) =
      (counit j).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj Q) ≫
        singleComplexOpenTensorRestrictionMap g' U U' j hj P
